project.name: Common (aggregator)
project.description: Aggregator for the two modules shared across every bounded context: common-domain (the entities ring, ADR-0019) and common-application (the shared presentation ring, ADR-0030). ADR-0031 groups them here and records why this is `common` rather than `common-service`, and why common-domain is a leaf where a context's -domain module is an aggregator. Build both with mvn -f common/pom.xml verify.
